definitions.explanation: A mathematical relationship in which one quantity increases (or decreases) in the same ratio as another — if one doubles, the other doubles. Contrasted with {反比例|はんぴれい} (inverse proportion). Also used in everyday Japanese to describe any situation where two things rise and fall together.

examples.japanese: {正比例|せいひれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧。
⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正比例|せいひれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: Effort and results are not always directly proportional.

examples.japanese: ⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{正比例|せいひれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧いく。
examples.english: The distance increases in direct proportion to the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{正比例|せいひれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The salary is directly proportional to the hours worked, so it increases by the amount of overtime.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ (direct, positive, correct) and ⟦{比例|ひれい}→比例：13215_hirei⟧ (proportion). In mathematics, two quantities x and y are in {正比例|せいひれい} when y = kx for some constant k — as x increases, y increases by the same ratio.

Beyond math class, the word appears in everyday discussion of cause-and-effect relationships, especially when people want to say that one thing rises and falls with another.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {正比例|せいひれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (a directly proportional relationship)
- As a suru-verb: A⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{正比例|せいひれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (A is directly proportional to B)
- Often used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (the standard of comparison is marked by ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正比例|せいひれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be directly proportional
- {正比例|せいひれい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: proportional relationship
- A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{正比例|せいひれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: B increases in direct proportion to A
- {正比例|せいひれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧: a graph of direct proportion (a straight line through the origin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反比例|はんぴれい}→反比例：18558_hanpirei⟧: inverse proportion — the direct antonym; as one increases, the other decreases proportionally
- ⟦{比例|ひれい}→比例：13215_hirei⟧: proportion (general) — often used when the direction (direct or inverse) is clear from context
- ⟦{連動|れんどう}→連動：14421_rendou⟧: moving together, linked movement — less mathematical; describes things that change together without specifying a ratio
